'''Dalia''' was the leader of a group of [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] colonists who settled the planet [[Dalicron-4]], approximately [[800 BBY/Legends|800 years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The colonists hoped to escape the hectic life of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The primary settlement on the planet, [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]], was named for this settler.
